kind: Predeclared single-factor fused-baseline development trial (development only; not an optimizer comparison)
factor: recipe profile: reduced Spatial 4-GPU profile (4 envs, 1 update per 64-decision window) -> unchanged native LIBERO-10 Joint PPO profile (8 envs, 16-decision windows, global_minibatch 32 = 4 updates per 128-decision window) on its native 8-GPU topology
unchanged: checkpoint, aligned_200 evaluation, seed 17, fused AdamW fp32_master, native lr 5e-6 / value_lr 1e-4 / betas / eps / decay / clip 1.0, BF16 compute, frozen backbone
success_criterion: PASS iff every completed aligned_200 evaluation at update >= 80 has success >= 0.885 (>= 177/200; frozen 90.5% minus 2 points) AND all-episode mean episode_steps <= 339.10 (frozen 308.27 + 10%). Any completed evaluation at update >= 80 violating either bound FAILS the trial. At least the update-80 evaluation must complete; otherwise the trial is censored, not passed.
falsification: The hypothesis 'the collapse was caused by the reduced 4-GPU profile' is falsified if this trial fails the criterion.
next_if_fail: At most two further single-factor trials, in order: (2) actor lr 5e-6 -> 1e-6 on the native profile; (3) value-warmup period. Each predeclared before submission.
no_selection: No checkpoint selection by inspected quality; results reported for all evaluations.

result.verdict: FAIL: update-80 success 0.270 < 0.885 and episode_steps 608.3 > 339.1. Hypothesis falsified: the collapse is not caused by the reduced 4-GPU profile (it is faster here: 80 updates = 20 windows).
result.status: CANCELLED after the failing update-80 evaluation

mechanism_note: The legacy native Joint PPO route (update_policy=parameter, adamw) updates BF16 parameters directly; per cosmos_framework/posttrain/config/rl.py OptimizerConfig docs, at lr ~5e-6 the relative BF16 update mostly rounds away. The native lr 5e-6 was therefore never exercised with fully effective updates; fp32_master applies them. This motivates trial 2 (actor lr 5e-6 -> 1e-6).
